svg.text: The Global Interpreter Lock: one thread runs bytecode at a time

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Threads still help enormously - they release the GIL while waiting on I/O.
